purpose: User-approved Dashboard settings and Home Assistant Geräte & Dienste configuration contracts. Change hashes only for an explicitly approved UI/configuration change. Since 0.26.4.2 the only settings surface is Devices & services; the dashboard settings centre was removed.
approved_changes: 0.26.4.6: one-dropdown reordering for goals/rooms, overnight presence hold option, several pollen sensors (user feedback)
0.26.4.7: outdoor fine dust protection – PM2.5 sensors under Outdoor air source, 'Consider outdoor fine dust' and limit under Air quality (user feedback; pending maintainer approval)
0.26.5.0: test notification text in the server language (English for non-German servers); no schema change (user request: English readiness before the community launch)
2026-10-16 (F12, owner-approved): options-flow room wizard applies its deferred structural reload so a newly added room gets its entities; no schema, form or text change
2026-10-16 (F12 trace, owner-approved work package): rejected room creation also traces the fixed form error codes (no names/entities); no schema, form or text change
0.26.5.1 (A-26, owner-approved): editing an existing room in the options flow is applied to the running integration (listeners rebuilt, refresh); no schema, form or text change
0.26.5.1 (feedback FAIQ-FB-7C943C054B43, owner-approved): notifications page gains 'Only notify recipients who are at home' (default off) and 'Send important warnings while away' (default on)
0.26.5.1 (owner request, approved): goal priorities 2 and 3 offer 'Off' – a switched-off CO2/temperature goal is hidden and starts no airing of its own; dehumidification cannot be switched off
0.26.5.1 (support case IKEA VINDSTYRKA, owner-approved): the VOC/TVOC picker accepts every sensor so unitless VOC index sensors can be chosen; field description explains the index scale

0.26.5.1 (A-27, owner-approved): temperature and humidity pickers offer sensors with the device class or a matching unit (°C/°F/K, %), so template/MQTT sensors without device class can be chosen; no text change

0.26.5.1 (owner request 2026-10-17, approved): optional automatic control – opening form 'Open the cover when this window/door opens' (restores the previous position on close; passage-door lock-out protection) and room section 'Automatic control' (sun protection, exhaust fan after a moisture source / following the recommendation, follow-up time, maximum runtime); all off by default; exhaust-fan texts no longer say the fan is never switched

0.26.5.1 (owner request 2026-10-17, approved): sun protection options 'Close covers ahead of the sun' (lead time, default 15 min), 'Warm day from forecast high' (default 25 °C) and 'No sun protection from cloud cover' (default 80 %)
0.26.5.2 (owner request 2026-10-18, approved): outdoor PM2.5 picker also offers sensors in µg/m³ and WAQI sensors; field description explains the WAQI index value
0.26.5.2 (owner request 2026-10-19, approved): editing a room applies the automatic cover/fan control at once (no visible change to the forms)
0.26.5.2 maintenance (owner request 2026-10-19, approved): config flow split into modules, schemas verified identical

0.26.5.3 (owner request 2026-10-23, approved): room sensors section gains 'Exhaust fan supply air: temperature/humidity (neighbouring room)' as an optional atomic pair, error exhaust_reference_pair_required

0.26.5.3 (owner request 2026-10-23, approved): stored values of clearable optional fields (entity, text, multi-select) are prefilled via suggested_value and an emptied field is saved as empty, so removed sensors/entries stay removed (per-window reference pair, covers, contacts, residents/presence, cross ventilation, notifications); no visible form or text change
0.26.5.3 (owner request 2026-10-23, approved): editing a room keeps goals switched 'off' (disabled_goals) and the room window orientation; no form or text change

0.26.5.3 (owner request 2026-10-23, approved, community feedback HarryP): notifications page gains 'Send status messages' (default on) and 'Reminder of an open action' (0 = off, 5-60 min); home setup gains the 'Open connections' pages (room, then connected rooms) for rooms connected without a door or contact

0.26.5.3 (owner request 2026-10-23, approved): every saved setting takes effect at once – the options dialog continues from changes saved elsewhere instead of overwriting them, and skips its own end-of-wizard reload when the running integration already reloaded for the room change; no form or text change

0.26.5.4 (owner request 2026-10-25, approved, GitHub #19): the 'Operating profile' details page is also shown for the comfort profile and offers only 'Cool from room temperature (lower limit)' (cooling_start_temp_c, 18-35 °C, default 24 °C); the field is renamed in both profiles (DE 'Kühlen frühestens ab Raumtemperatur', formerly 'Sommerkühlung ab Raumtemperatur') and its description explains the comfort target rule; page description extended; summer cooling page unchanged otherwise

0.26.5.4 (owner request 2026-10-25, approved): 'Diagnostics sharing' page names the benefit of sharing (new rooms learn faster, more accurate forecasts, faults fixed sooner) and says plainly that nothing is sent without consent; the outdated statements 'on by default during the beta' and 'local staging hub only' are replaced by the actual behaviour (opt-in, HTTPS, nightly after consent); consent option 'Yes, share and improve FreshAirIQ (pseudonymised)'; no schema change

0.26.5.5 (owner request 2026-10-28, approved, community diagnosis): room section 'Automatic control' gains the optional field 'Other automation controls the fan' (exhaust_fan_external_lock: input_boolean/binary_sensor/switch/timer) – while it is on, FreshAirIQ leaves the room's fans to that automation and never switches them off; an emptied field is saved as empty

0.26.5.5 (owner request 2026-11-02, approved): room section 'Automatic control' gains the optional lock period 'Exhaust fan lock period – start/end' (exhaust_fan_block_start/_end, time selectors; both empty = off; may span midnight) – inside it FreshAirIQ does not switch the fan on and switches off a fan it switched on; every opening form gains 'Kind of opening' (contact_kind: not stated / window / door, default not stated) for more precise advice and the house map; older setups keep working without the fields

0.26.6.0 (owner request 2026-11-02, approved): 'Advanced model parameters' → 'Mould & CO₂' gains the two lower mould risk limits 'Slightly elevated' (mould_slight_surface_rh, default 60 %) and 'Elevated' (mould_elevated_surface_rh, default 70 %) next to 'High' (warn) and 'Very high' (critical); all four must rise strictly (invalid_mould_order); older setups keep their values and get the defaults

0.26.6.1 (owner order 2026-11-06, approved): Devices & services → room setup (add, edit, import from a Home Assistant area, room subentry) gains the optional field 'Mold indicator (HA helper)' (mold_indicator; only entities of the mold_indicator integration; issue #21); Cross ventilation validates the pairs and accepts unique room names, stores room keys only and names malformed, unknown, ambiguous, same-room and repeated pairs (error cross_pairs_invalid with the detail, DE/EN; issue #25)

0.26.7.0 (owner request 2026-11-06, approved): the menu 'Notifications & energy' gains the page 'Automation lock (e.g. holidays)' with one optional entity (automation_lock_entity: input_boolean, switch, binary sensor, timer or schedule; empty = no lock) – while it is on FreshAirIQ starts no automatic device action and only ends the airing it started itself; a status binary sensor 'Automation lock' for other automations

0.26.7.0 (owner order 'Logikprüfung, Innentüren und UX', point 1/2, approved): the per-opening form gains 'Opening leads to' (outside / another room, stored only for inside openings – existing contacts stay outside) with the explanation of inside doors and the optional 'Connected room'; error contact_side_conflict refuses a contact classified differently in another room; per-contact metadata pruning moved into one helper

0.26.7.0 (owner order 'Hotfix F05–F08 + zusätzliche UI-/Textfehler', U04/T01–T04, approved): error connected_room_outside explains that 'Connected room' only applies to inside doors instead of dropping a room chosen for an outside opening silently (the prefilled room of a door switched to outside still goes with the side change); the connected-room label/description, the legacy cross-ventilation pairs description, the contact-mode option labels and descriptions and the contact_side_conflict error use the owner's wording in German and English.

0.26.7.0 (owner order 'Hassfest-Hotfix', approved): hassfest schema errors removed – options.selector (never read; every selector text is at the top level), the older duplicate options.step.<id>.section (Home Assistant shows 'sections', whose texts are unchanged) and the missing config_subentries.room.entry_type (Raum/Room) added; no visible text of a form changes.
